app.subtitle: Small steps. Growing possibilities.
welcome: A little focus, a world to explore.
welcome.sub: Understand your child’s starting point, then make room for practice.
children.title: Every journey starts here
children.sub: A personal space for each child. Profiles stay on this device.
deleteConfirm: Delete this child and all their local sessions? This cannot be undone.
selectChild: Select or add a child to begin.
noRecords: No sessions yet. Your child’s own observations will appear here.
baseline.title: Start with understanding
baseline.sub: Six short activities. One personal starting point.
baseline.desc: Six short activities, 8–12 formal questions each, about 5–8 minutes with explanations. Practice comes first; take a break whenever needed.
principle: Their starting point. Their own pace.
disclaimer: For practice and personal observation only. This is not a medical assessment, diagnosis, or comparison with other children.
report.title: An ability profile, not a label
report.sub: Independent observations, grounded in what actually happened.
science.implementation: An independent child-friendly adaptation, not an equivalent administration of a validated test.
science.limitations: Small samples, comprehension, motor input, device timing and breaks can affect results. Training transfer and clinical validity have not been established.
insufficient: Practice did not establish rule comprehension. No formal interpretation is available for this activity.
finding.OBSERVED: This observation summarizes the completed, timing-valid trials in this activity.
finding.COMMISSION_DOMINANT: Responses on wait trials occurred more often than missed responses on tap trials.
finding.INSTRUCTION_LOAD_DROP: Accuracy was lower on three-step instructions than on two-step instructions.
finding.TIMING_EXCLUDED: Interrupted trials were excluded from the reported performance metrics.
compare: Compared with the first completed baseline
comparisonUnavailable: Complete another assessment with this protocol to compare observations.
training.title: Make space for small steps
training.sub: Choose a direction. We prepare a short, finite session.
fallback: AI content generation is unavailable or not configured. Using built-in training content.
training.evidence: Suggestions follow recorded error patterns, not a clinical priority or an overall score.
training.manual: No baseline evidence yet. You can choose activities manually.
history.title: Your child’s own journey
history.sub: Assessments and practice are kept separate.
settings.title: Quietly working in the background
settings.sub: A local-first experience. AI is always optional.
settings.env: Configure these variables in the server .env file, then restart. API keys never enter the browser.
settings.privacy: Profiles, trials and event logs stay in this browser’s IndexedDB. Clearing browser data removes them. Export regularly. AI receives only age, content parameters, or a minimal evidence packet when you request it.
aiReportFallback: Using deterministic observations. AI explanation is unavailable.
done.sub: Thank you for taking one small step. Time for a break.
again: Almost. Let’s try the next one.
practiceRetry: Let’s watch the example and try once more.
skipTask: Let’s leave this one for another day.
sequenceInstruction: Tap these objects in this order:
error: Something could not be saved. Please retry; keep this page open.
instruction.GNG: Tap Go when the green light and arrow appear. When the red light and stop sign appear, keep your hands still.
instruction.SA: Watch the observation window. Tap Found a star only when a star appears. Wait when the moon appears.
instruction.FLANKER: Look at the arrow in the middle. Choose the direction it points.
instruction.CORSI: Watch the squares light up. Then tap the same squares in the same order.
instruction.DCCS: First match the color. Later, match the shape. Watch the rule above the card.
instruction.INSTRUCTION: Listen or look at the pictures. Tap the objects in the requested order.
training.noSuggestion: No specific error pattern suggests a priority. Choose activities manually.
instruction.GNG.legacy: Tap the leaf. When the moon appears, keep your hands still.
instruction.SA.legacy: Watch carefully. Tap only when the leaf appears. Wait for all other pictures.
redLight: Red light with a stop sign
shortProtocolNote: This short protocol uses small samples. Results describe this session only; compare assessments within the same protocol version.
